messages.subject: [statnet_help] Interactions with term.options = options(interact.dependent = 'silent')
messages.body_plain:
Hey Statnet Team,
This one is (probably) for Pavel.
I want to add interactions to Bergm and need to pass the options(interact.dependent = 'silent') but I seem to be doing something wrong.
How do I pass it properly to the control argument?
 
I got these code snippets (and other related ones):
simulate(...,control = control.simulate(...,  term.options = options(interact.dependent = 'silent')))
control <- control.ergm(..., term.options = options(interact.dependent = 'silent'))
 
I assume I am just putting it in the wrong place or calling it wrong.

Thank you,
Robert

messages.subject: [statnet_help] Interactions with term.options = options(interact.dependent = 'silent')
messages.body_plain:
Hi, Robert,

It should be list(), not options(). You can set term options globally using options(ergm.term = list(...)) as well. Though, why are you getting these warnings in the first place?

Best,
Pavel
